items.title: Pullback along a morphism whose source covers the base is fully faithful on descent data
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X to X' over S with the single morphism X to S an fpqc covering, the lemma shows that the pullback functor on descent data from X' over S to X over S is fully faithful (statement lines 8932-8939). The proof factors the morphism through the fibre product X times over S with X', observes that the first factor has a section and therefore induces an equivalence of categories of descent data, and that the second factor is an fpqc covering and therefore induces a fully faithful functor (proof lines 8942-8948). The claim is H2: the content is the correct factorization and the observation that the two factors fall under the two available statements, both named and both applicable for reasons the author states.
